limitations: These are transparent sequence descriptors, not experimental safety, stability, potency, or target binding evidence.
The hydrophobic moment is an idealized alpha-helical projection and does not establish peptide secondary structure.
Canonical sequences do not encode terminal capping, cyclization, D-residues, or other chemical modifications.
The Guruprasad index was derived from proteins; short peptides below 20 residues are marked out-of-domain.
The protein-reference value 40 is explanatory only, never a peptide hard gate, and is not serum, protease, or shelf stability.
